# BoardGamesWithQuests product requirements

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/generate_documents.py; edit source records instead. -->


## Implemented repository product components

### Board-game definition input

The repository installs `chess` and `checkers` packages with schema-versioned JSON metadata. `engine.model.game.configuration` validates names, playable/default flags, board dimensions, starting-square occupancy, piece symbols and movement vectors, clock metadata, appearance and export identifiers. Installed game entry points provide discovery. The shipped JSON declares an 8×8 board for each game, with chess and English draughts starting-piece arrangements.

### Python engine and control

`packages/engine/` contains a `GameManager` that coordinates board state, players, move attempts, turn alternation and terminal-state evaluation. A `MoveValidator` exposes chess check, checkmate, stalemate and legal-move checks. The board, chess pieces, clocks, quest primitives, user data, logging and notation/export components are separate Python modules. `GameController` accepts board-square selections and routes move actions to the game manager.

### Application and observability

The declared `chesswithquests` GUI-script entry point invokes `engine.app.main`. Its `--check` mode reports installed configurations and package version without a display. The shipped game definitions currently mark themselves non-playable; the entry point checks that flag before attempting GUI startup. Module existence and passing non-GUI checks are not equivalent to a completed playable desktop distribution.

### Documentation and verification

`.agents/` holds current-component documentation sources and source-derived diagrams; `.github/` holds the workflows, documentation publisher, checks and tests. DarkFactory PrideVer is configured as the versioning authority. The v1 desktop packaging and release acceptance work is tracked separately in the [delivery plan](roadmap/v1.0.0.md), not represented here as implemented gameplay.
